g.aria-label: Title text 'One sensor cannot tell walking from a head shake. Two can.'

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: One sensor cannot tell walking from a head shake. Two can.

g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Both are vigorous neck motion, so any scalar built from the collar alone bins them together. The back harness resolves it as a shape: in locomotion the sensors move together, in a head shake only one moves.'

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Both are vigorous neck motion, so any scalar built from the collar alone bins them together.
The back harness resolves it as a shape: in locomotion the sensors move together, in a head shake only one moves.

text.aria-label: t: Source: TELLTAIL RAW.COLLAR_TELEMETRY (100 Hz dual IMU) joined to STAGING.EPOCH_FEATURES. r is CORR(vm_neck, vm_back) computed in Snowflake over the same one-second epoch. Two real seconds, not composites.
text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Source: TELLTAIL RAW.COLLAR_TELEMETRY (100 Hz dual IMU) joined to STAGING.EPOCH_FEATURES.
r is CORR(vm_neck, vm_back) computed in Snowflake over the same one-second epoch. Two real seconds, not composites.
